components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for submit and progress actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0071E3; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0077ED; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #006EDB; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 113, 227, 0.35); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #1D1D1F; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid #D2D2D7; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; outline: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F5F5F7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 113, 227, 0.35); }

narrative.overview: PrintEasy is an Apple HIG-inspired, institutional printing management interface designed for clarity, quiet confidence, and operational speed. It strips away visual noise—eliminating decorative gradients, arbitrary drop shadows, and unanchored accent colors—to focus entirely on document preparation and status certainty.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained Single-Accent System: #0071E3 is reserved for interactive affordances.
Structural Elevation: Depth is communicated via 1px hairline dividers (#D2D2D7) and neutral surfaces (#FFFFFF on #F5F5F7).
Micro-Hierarchy: Tabular numerals prevent jitter during operational queue refreshes.

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary blue accent (#0071E3) must never appear on more than two focal points simultaneously on any screen.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: All counters, copy quantities, page ranges, queue timestamps, and file sizes must declare tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Hairline Primacy Rule
rules.body: Depth is created first by the 1px #D2D2D7 border. Shadows serve only as secondary ambient grounding; they are never colored.

dos: Do wrap every number, price, date, and page count in tabular-nums.
Do use sentence case on all labels, badges, and headings.
Do maintain a strict 44px touch target on all staff workstation actions.
Do constrain desktop views to max-w-[1200px].
donts: Don't introduce third-party accent colors such as Tailwind purples, oranges, or magentas.
Don't use colored glow shadows (e.g. shadow-blue-500/20).
Don't use uppercase on badges or labels.
Don't communicate state through color alone.
